comments: 34e0ba1f: This section of code handles the interaction with the user for editing or adding deficiencies to a patient record.
0b763658: Prompt the user for the event date with no default.
fe03e338: Check if the event date is after the admission date; if not, reset to admission date.
78b821e5: Ensure the event date is not after the discharge date; if it is, reset to discharge date.
ead107c3: If the document type is an IRT (Incomplete Record Tracking), set last movement for patient.
85487272: For non-IRT documents, set the event date to either the specified time or the end of the day if no time is provided.
d6d39761: Retrieve the last patient movement information.
369012d1: Clear and optionally set default answer for the next prompt.
124d1aae: Prompt for ward location, with default if available, and determine the ward service.
1f8ed0bb: If there's a specialty associated, set it as the default answer for the next prompt.
691d3c2c: Prompt for the service, with specialty as the default if it was previously set.
46af48b4: If the ward is not found in the hospital location file, use the service from the clinic stop.
c8a04fe1: If the ward is found, use its service section.
3decbf57: Determine the service to use for the deficiency based on the ward or clinic service.
21963b56: Prompt for the service related to the deficiency.
bf5fefe1: If revising, set the default responsible physician based on the deficiency.
14d29e65: Prompt for the first responsible physician.
6c106492: Set the default value for the second physician based on the deficiency being active.
23acfc79: For inactive deficiencies, set the default second responsible physician.
cfbec43a: Prompt for the second responsible physician, with defaults based on deficiency status.
3c46fcbb: Set the default value for the primary resident based on the first responsible physician.
1d0bb145: Prompt for the primary resident involved in the deficiency.
edeb1c53: File the new or edited deficiency record into the database.
8577e6e9: Set the edit date to now and prepare to enter specific deficiency data.
29f8b887: If not a specific set of document types, use a default form for data entry.
713d597d: For specific document types, use a specialized form for data entry.
f785271e: Execute the data entry form logic.
df2be85d: Reinitialize the list view after data entry completion.
816e5987: If the user exits early or times out, reset the view to the top of the list.
66add81f: End the subroutine and return to the calling routine.
c3f10d43: Count the number of deficiencies for a patient that haven't been completed.
8876ba2a: Exit the script for counting deficiencies.
9119c20c: Check if the division matches before increasing count; includes setting up variables for the check.
f093d4cf: Update the global with the deficiency count for the category.
b605bc69: Exit the subroutine for processing a single deficiency record.
d6c0cc00: Check if the division of the deficiency matches the user's division.
a81d52e4: Set the default deficiency status based on division settings.
2cf39d19: Determine the default status code for the deficiency based on its review state.
d8cc876f: Handles document retrieval and assignment logic for deficiency processing.
725cda82: Convert the physician's internal entry number to a name.
10fdb7df: This code block determines the responsible physician for a deficiency based on various criteria.
1cf32ae5: Set the responsible physician based on the document's status and admission info.
8e732584: End of the subroutine for setting the responsible physician.
19a342c0: Determine the treatment type based on the patient movement record.
95ad7143: Exit the subroutine for determining treatment type.
473ddab2: Prepares the environment for generating the deficiency list for a patient.
b13fdd39: Clear the temporary global used to store the report data.
632d51ba: Initialize variables for counting and tracking list positions.
91b9af7e: Prepare the initial state for generating the deficiency list view.
b9aef9eb: Set a message in the temporary global if no deficiencies were found.
2425b06f: Call the routine to generate the deficiency list view.
0b1ee403: Exit the subroutine for temporary list preparation.
2205d350: Process the jump command from the list view to a specific deficiency category.
d45f2061: Prompt the user to select a category for navigation.
e41e40f4: Handle user exit or timeout during category selection.
3c42f4bb: Retry category selection if an invalid category is chosen.
bab6efc9: Prepare to set the selected category for jumping.
cffd169e: Store the user's category selection.
f92e0d09: Warn if the selected category contains no deficiencies.
0f98b718: Adjust the list view to the selected category's first deficiency.
45ffd56e: End of the jump processing routine.
